Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid

Class BBFluidHandler

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid.AbstractFluidHandler
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid.BBFluidHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraftforge.fluids.capability.IFluidHandler, net.minecraftforge.fluids.capability.IFluidHandlerItem
public class BBFluidHandler extends AbstractFluidHandler
Forge item fluid handler for a finite Big or Huge Bucket. It exposes one tank whose capacity comes from the item tier and persists executed fills and drains in the container's shared NBT format.

    • fillEmpty

      protected int fillEmpty(net.minecraftforge.fluids.FluidStack resource, net.minecraftforge.fluids.capability.IFluidHandler.FluidAction action)
      Description copied from class: AbstractFluidHandler
      Accepts fluid into an empty container.

      The resource is nonempty and has passed AbstractFluidHandler.canAcceptFluid(net.minecraftforge.fluids.FluidStack); the container is in NONE mode or has an empty fluid payload. A simulated action must report the same accepted amount without mutating AbstractFluidHandler.container. An executing action may mutate it.

      Specified by:
      fillEmpty in class AbstractFluidHandler
      Returns:
      amount accepted, from zero through resource.getAmount()

    • performDrain

      protected net.minecraftforge.fluids.FluidStack performDrain(net.minecraftforge.fluids.FluidStack resource, net.minecraftforge.fluids.capability.IFluidHandler.FluidAction action)
      Description copied from class: AbstractFluidHandler
      Drains a requested amount from the current compatible fluid payload.

      The base class has established that the container holds a nonempty fluid equal to resource. Simulation must return what execution can supply without mutating the container. Execution owns any finite debit; infinite handlers may return fluid unchanged.

      Specified by:
      performDrain in class AbstractFluidHandler
      Returns:
      fluid actually supplied, matching the stored content and never exceeding the request
